properties.note: This open question is BOUND by the accepted rule rather than competing with it: dec:what-lives-where already says the design record should stop being prose you navigate and become a graph you query. The question here is only what that means mechanically for the backlog, and what vocabulary is missing before it can happen. Drawn deliberately — an idea node with only AUTHORED_BY is invisible to propagate_from and to the orphan detector (BL-209), which is how dec:export-once-per-pr came to be violated by the session that then re-announced it.
